name: Ring Spin
description: The frame is cut into concentric rings that spin like the dials of a combination lock, in alternating directions and blurred with speed, one after another from the center outward; each ring overshoots a little and locks into place on the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: rings
params.description: Number of rings, from the center to the farthest corner

params.name: square
params.description: Square rings, like nested frames, instead of round ones

params.name: turns
params.description: Full turns made by each ring

params.name: stagger
params.description: Delay between the first ring and the last one, as a part of the transition

params.name: blur
params.description: Amount of angular motion blur while the rings spin fast

params.name: settle
params.description: Size of the overshoot when a ring locks
